revision_summary: Two timestamp errors need correcting: (1) rep_intent.evidence[2] cites [05:07] for the quote 'I'll send a message to you, just right after this call, and then we can kinda finish up through text.' — this quote actually occurs at [05:35]; fix the ts. (2) script_coverage bill_collection section cites customer_quote 'Can you text me, the the information?' at ts [04:42] — that ts is actually when the rep asks about mail/online bills; the customer's text-me line occurs around [05:20]-[05:27]; correct the ts. Both are minor wrong_ts errors (words exist, timestamps off), not fabrications, but should be corrected on rerun. Additionally: (3) tighten schema_reference citations — 'protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number' misapplied to the headquarters-location fumble (no exact match exists; either drop the reference or note it as unmapped), 'coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features' misapplied to the missed follow-up on customer's children already having solar (should reference verify.items.prior_designs or be left unmapped), and 'interest_reason_audit' used as a schema_reference when it's actually Stage 3's own output field name, not an Ion textbook section (should cite verify.items.interest_in_solar instead). (4) Reconsider the objections entry for the repeated headquarters/panel-origin/location questions — these read as curious verification questions from an engaged, cooperative customer rather than a resisted objection needing 3 handling attempts; the 'rep_attempts: 3' framing overstates conflict that doesn't match the customer's consistently friendly tone. (5) Soften or reconsider the 05:14 state_change label 'engaged questioner -> disengaging' — the customer thanks the rep, asks Holland's name, and says a warm goodbye at 05:47-05:51, which suggests the call ended on cooperative/friendly footing due to a real-world interruption rather than emotional disengagement from the pitch.
